title: Galvanic Bloom
description: A detuned saw swarm bass that blooms upward from a sub growl into a screaming full-spectrum riser, accelerating in pitch as a band-pass sweep climbs and resonance tightens to a metallic ring. Over the 32-cycle arc the voice corrodes through rising distortion and squiz pitch-mangle, then collapses back to the sub to loop.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<e1 e1 e2 b1>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .accelerate(saw.slow(16).range(0, 0.6))
    .penv("<0 0 7 19>/8").pattack(0.02).pdecay(0.5)
    .detune(sine.slow(11).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .off(0.005, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.5))
    .off(0.011, x => x.add(note(-0.18)).gain(0.45))
    .bpf(saw.slow(8).range(180, 5200)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(8, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.3)
    .distort(saw.slow(32).range(0.1, 4.5))
    .squiz("<1 1 2 4>/16")
    .crush("<16 12 8 6>/16")
    .noise(sine.slow(24).range(0.0, 0.25))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.3).sustain(0.6).release(0.1)
    .delay("0.3:0.1875:0.6").room(0.25)
    .gain(0.9)
)
